title: Illumination flares: fight by flarelight at night
summary: At night men see only a short way. Mortars now fire star shells: magnesium flares that drift down under parachutes, light the ground and everyone on it, and throw shadows that swing as they fall. The AI lights up night attacks too.
stage: Native Godot 4.7.2 Forward+, --scenario=flares --seed=1 (night), High preset, --fixed-fps 30, 1280x720, command camera --focus=12,-30 --zoom=70 --pitch=-10 --nohud; 300 frames from t=50 s (--screenshot series, --shot-every=0.03333), the first flare's last ten seconds of burn.
rationale: A flare's point is motion: the drift, the swing under the chute and the light and shadows moving with it. A short real-gameplay clip shows that; a still can't.
source_ref: Branch dines/xenodochial-archimedes-b623aa on main 3c044b8a. Frame 288 was lost to a full disk during capture and replaced by frame 287. Encoded VP9 CRF 40 with Playwright's ffmpeg (JPEG on pipe:0).

sources.caption: A night attack (the flares scenario): a star shell's flare swings under its chute as it comes down over the field and gutters out; its light falls away to dark beyond the house, and the shadows shift with it. Real gameplay, fixed 30 Hz, High preset.
Poster: frame 150 (t=55 s), the flare low over the field.
